title: Replace per-message direct Discord jobs with local per-scope coordinators and delegated workers
constraints: Do not access or mutate OnMam, GCP, church sites, databases, or migration jobs
Preserve the proven Gateway, authorization, private SQLite ledger, child isolation, and systemd ownership
Do not automatically replay historical recovery_review jobs
A Discord receipt or status projection must never gate model work
One failed worker or delivery must not block later messages in the same scope
key_decisions: Replace only the conversation and work-dispatch layer; do not rewrite the transport or security core
Maintain one provider-neutral local coordinator record per Discord DM/channel/thread scope
Coordinator turns are serialized per scope and remain responsive while delegated workers run independently
Codex/Claude workers remain isolated subprocesses without Discord credentials
Acknowledgements and progress reports are best-effort outputs, not execution preconditions

plan.task: Freeze the v2 coordinator and non-blocking delivery contracts
plan.verification: two-agent planning review plus contract tests

plan.task: Add provider-neutral per-scope state, policy revision, and bounded continuity
plan.verification: policy rotation and encrypted recovery coverage

plan.task: Replace per-message direct execution with coordinator reply-or-delegate routing
plan.verification: active-worker status and coordinator synthesis tests

plan.task: Decouple acknowledgement, progress, final delivery, and historical review state
plan.verification: receipt failure and delivery-unknown lifecycle tests

plan.task: Replace false-green status and preservation gates with user-outcome metrics
plan.verification: current work, historical unresolved, and delivery issue separation

plan.task: Run full deterministic, build, adversarial, and isolated live Discord tests
plan.verification: focused suite passes; full build blocked by absent worktree dependencies; isolated live rollout pending

plan.task: Deploy one instance at a time with rollback and no historical auto-replay

alternatives.reason: The acknowledgement gate and ephemeral-session model are the root architecture, not isolated bugs
Gateway, authorization, state privacy, process isolation, and service ownership are independently useful and tested
Smallest change that restores the user-approved coordinator/subagent model

premortem: A coordinator resume failure strands a scope: reseed a fresh coordinator from bounded Discord history and durable open-work summaries
A long worker blocks conversation: coordinator and worker lanes are separate; only coordinator turns serialize
REST send failure recreates head-of-line blocking: delivery never participates in queue admission or worker launch
